notes.title: Update notes for 11/11 patch
notes.content:
Cheers! Here's the first update post-launch. The update fixes several bugs, so do update the game.


 Fixed a code input bug on the restaurant level
 Fixed a logic issue on the second ending regarding a puzzle
 Fixed an issue with a hotspot on the first nomad level
 Fixed an NPC visibility bug on prison level
 FIxed an animation issue in the circus level


Happy gaming!

notes.title: Our Next Fest demo is out!
notes.content:
Greetings! Although Next Fest kicks into gear officially next Monday, we wanted to start the festivities early. We have just released a massively upgraded demo, which includes a whole lot of new stuff. Your feedback has been extremely valuable, and we’ve taken that to heart while revising the game.

In this update, you’ll find:


 Triple the content! You should definitely start a new game more than once. There are loads of new content for you to consume

 Completely revised inventory system. You use items to hotspots by selecting them from the inventory while you’re on top of a hotspot instead of them being used automatically if you happened to carry them

 Saving! You can actually save your progress. What madness!

 New fonts for better readability

 Polished UI & graphics


Have fun playing!

Oh, and if you haven't seen our amazing trailer, here's that too
